Commentary.Commentary: Right then! West Indies have denied India to take a 2-0 lead in this 4-match Test series and given themselves a huge chance to make a comeback. The 3rd Test begins on 9th August, 2016 in Gros Islet. Will we see the Windies putting up an identical performance with the willow? Join us on the above mentioned date to find it out. Until next time, it's goodbye and good night from us. Cheers!

Roston Chase, Man of the Match is really delighted that he could help his team draw a Test match. (On what he loves more?) He feels that he can do both (batting and bowling) for his team but shows a little more preference towards batting. Further says they knew they had an uphill task and is glad that he chipped in and played a pivotal knock. Ends by saying he would have loved his side winning the match but will take this result due to his contribution.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli feels it was a testing time for them and that is what this format is all about. He feels that they lost a day yesterday due to rains but admits that can't be given as an excuse. Credits the hosts for the way they have played today. (On the track) He adds that the hardness of the ball was a factor and on such pitches when the cherry is not hard, the play goes dead for 25-30 overs. Admits that the hosts played really well to keep them at bay. Appreciates the batting skills shown by Ajinkya Rahane and KL Rahul. Ends by saying Rahul came as a replacement and much to his delight he grabbed the opportunity that was on offer with both the hands.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder feels that they have improved a lot. He adds that they really batted well as Blackwood and Chase played the game ball by ball. (On their turnaround) He says that they have put in their efforts and that paid off. Further says unlike the last match they showed a lot of character which is what helped them to get better. (On their batting) He states that they played well and all have shown good intent. Ends by saying Roston Chase was the key coming into the side and doing so well. (On the third match) He hopes that his side should show some faith and remain patient to meet the success.

The Indians will be really, really bewailed as they were Chased out of what was arguably their Test. They started the match on a positive note by bowling the home side out for 196 and then going on to post a huge total of 500. KL Rahul and Ajinkya Rahane both scored tons which in the end couldn't reap dividends. Agreed, the weather played its part and we saw the sessions getting washed out on day 3 and 4. Huge amount of time was lost but one would still feel, the Indians very well had a chance to bundle out West Indies and win this by an innings. Nevertheless, both teams have played up to their potential and have provided sheer entertainment to the cricketing fans. Let's see what the captains have got to say....

Blackwood and Chase laid a strong foundation and it was quite evident that they weren't playing for the draw. They kept scoring at a brisk rate and once Blackwood departed, Shane Dowrich and Jason Holder came to the fore and battled it out with the new star, Roston Chase. Both of them scored their respective fifties followed by a ton from Chase. What a match he has had as he grabbed his maiden 5-fer and a ton in the same game, marvelous stuff.

What a match, this is the beauty of Test cricket. Who would have thought the match would be ending this way. With a full day left, no predictions of rains, 6 wickets in hands and a mammoth trail of 256, West Indies needed to bat out of their skins and boy, weren't they outstanding? They showed a great level of aggression, defense and panache and it all started with Jermaine Blackwood and Roston Chase in the first session earlier in the day.

The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Good length ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
Full and angling in on middle, Chase gets back to flick but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Good length delivery on off, Chase shoulders his arms to that one.

What was that? Full and down the leg side, Chase looks to flick it across the line but misses. Saha dives full length to his left to stop but gets hit on the chest. Kohli from first slip gets to the ball and reverse flicks it towards the batsman. Chase shows full face of the bat to fend it away. Kohli isn't happy and goes to the umpire as the batsman can't put his bat unless and until the ball is declared dead. Some words being shared by the two.
Lovely bowling! Bowls a length delivery on off, holds its line and just moves away a bit. Roston looks to defend it off the back foot but the ball goes just past his willow to the keeper.
Fires a yorker on the stumps, Chase does well to dig it out.
Ishant Sharma will bowl from the other end.
Fuller ball on the leg stump, Chase neatly tickles it to fine leg for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, Chase drives it to mid on.
Similar ball on off, it swigs in after pitching yet again. Roston off the front foot pushes it to the off side.
Length ball on off, Chase gets ahead and defends it to covers.
Fuller on the pads, Chase off his back foot flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball on off, angling in after pitching. Chase just like before lunch strides forward and defends it.

We are ready to get underway for the second session of the last day. The first 30 minutes will be interesting to watch. It will be Roston Chase and Shane Dowrich to continue with the bat. Umesh Yadav will start off with the ball.
... DAY 5, SESSION 2 ...

Just when the Indians thought they could bowl out the hosts, Chase along with Dowrich came to the fore and kept the scoreboard ticking. Roston too made a good half century and is going strong. They have reduced the deficit to just 89 runs and come the next session, they would look to wipe it off. The Indians will like to regroup and address the issue as soon possible, if they have to win this match. Will India come out to bat again? Well, only time will tell. Do join us for the post-Lunch session in a while.

West Indies have won this session hands down as more than 160 runs were scored with the affect of 1 wicket only. At one stage they were trailing by 256 before coming on to bat today with just 6 wickets left. Blackwood and Chase showed positive intent and went after the Indian bowlers from the word go. The duo dealt with the inswingers and looseners with great grit. The former went on to make yet another fifty in this match before he got out off Ashwin's tossed up ball. Their stand was a pacy one as they stitched 93 runs together.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Shane gets forward and works it towards leg slip. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 5!
Floated ball around off, Dowrich lunges forward and defends it down.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot.
On the pads, it's flatter as well. Tucked towards square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Short on middle and leg, the batsman gets back and flicks it towards mid on.
Full on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Fullish on off, driven straight to covers.
Fuller length delivery on off, Chase gets forward, opens the face of the bat and guides it past backward point for a couple.
On a good length and nipping in a bit. Roston defends it off the back foot.
Angles it on the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards covers for a single.
Umesh Yadav into the attack now!
Gets back and defends it solidly.

FOUR! Swept away fine! Loopy ball around leg, Dowrich gets down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary. Mishra comes across to his right but was never going to stop that one.
Full and around middle, Dowrich defends it off the front foot.
Shane gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Loopy ball around off, turning in a bit. Dowrich looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Tossed up around middle and off, Dowrich defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, steered towards point for no runs.
In the channel outside off, Chase shoulders his arms.
Full and around off, getting some away swing there. Chase somehow manages to push it towards covers.
Fuller length delivery on off, driven towards Sharma at covers.
On a length and outside off, Shane gets back and punches it through covers for a couple.
Full and angling into the batsman. Dowrich digs it out in time as he is well set now.
Low full toss outside off, Dowrich makes room and drills it through covers. Won't get a boundary but will get an easy three there.
Shane has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Once again it's Kohli who gives it a chase. Loopy ball around middle, Dowrich gets down on one knee and looks to sweep. Gets a top edge towards fine leg for a couple.
Full and around off, driven towards mid off.
Loopy ball around middle, Chase gets down to sweep but gets a top edge that flies over Kohli at leg slip. He gives it a chase and allows them to take just a single.
Shortish on middle, Dowrich gets back and pulls it towards square leg for one.
Touch short and outside off, defended towards covers.
Outside off, left alone.
Back of a length ball on middle, RC shows full face of the bat.
Walks across to this full length delivery and flicks it towards mid on.
On a length and straightens a bit after pitching. Chase looks to defend but gets squared up due to the extra bounce as the ball just goes off the outside edge.

FOUR! Runs are flowing for the home side it seems! Tad short and sits up at a nice height for Chase. He stays put inside the crease and pulls it off the base of the bat through square leg for a boundary.
Driven through mid-on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Tossed up around middle, Dowrich whips it through mid on. Ishant gives it a chase and keeps them down to a single.
Full and around middle, Dowrich works it towards the leg side.
Tossed up around off, Shane looks to defend but gets an outside edge which doesn't carry to Rahane stationed at first slip.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Loopy delivery around middle, Dowrich flicks it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
Good length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot and into the ground. A maiden over to start this spell.
Another short ball and this time served outside off, the batsman arches back and evade it. That was a sharp delivery from the pacer.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Chase looks to duck under it but the ball brushes his shoulders and goes towards the keeper.
Angles a length delivery on off, Chase looks to defend it towards the off side but gets an inside edge towards Kohli at short mid-wicket.
On a length and around off, Roston defends it back to Shami.
Fuller length delivery on off, Chase defends it strongly off the front foot towards covers.
Mohammed Shami is brought back into the attack!
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a loopy delivery around middle. Dowrich gets down and sweeps it towards mid-wicket for an easy couple.
Loopy ball outside off, Dowrich prods and drives it past covers for a brace.
Landed outside off, turning in. Dowrich looks to defend but is beaten up the turn and is hit on the pads.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot and back to the bowler.
Full and around middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Ashwin gives a bit more flight, Dowrich looks to flick it towards the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Fuller outside off, Chase off his back foot plays it through covers for a brace.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Chase off his long stride pushes it to mid on.
Tad short on off, cut to point.
Mishra serves it full on middle and leg, Chase gets forward and blocks it to the bowler.
Tossed up ball outside off, Chase cuts it over covers for a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter in length, Shane gets back and clips it towards square leg for no runs.
Full and around off, the batsman presses forward and defends it gently.
Tad short and around off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Loopy ball around middle and off, defend gently.
On middle and leg, Shane flicks it towards the leg side.
Dowrich gets back and pushes it towards point.
Tossed up around off, Chase lunges forward to defend but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball around off, Chase pushes it towards covers.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Chase defends it down.
Flatter one on middle, defended off the back foot.
Loopy ball around middle, it's the googly. Chase gets forward to flick but misses as the ball goes off his pads towards first slip.
FOUR! Mishra bowls a half tracker on middle, Chase camps back and pulls it with disdain towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
It is a floater ball on off, Dowrich gets to the pitch of tha ball and pushes it to covers.
The ball has found the edge of the bat.
Serves it full on middle and leg, pushed to mid on.
Ashwin serves it outside off, it comes in after pitching. Dowrich comes forward and drives it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played it to the point region
Tossed up ball on off, the batsman defends it.
Maiden Test fifty for Roston Chase!
FOUR! Brings up the 50 in style! Mishra bowls a low full toss on the pads, Chase gleefully whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. What a sensational knock from Roston!
Short and around off, turning away after pitching. Chase defends it awkwardly.
Loopy ball around leg, helped towards the leg side.
On middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Chase works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
On middle and leg, flicked toward the leg side.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT! Loopy delivery around middle and off, Chase makes a long stride forward to defend but the ball straightens a bit but misses. Saha behind the stumps flicks the bails off and appeals for a stumping. The umpire refer it upstairs and replays show his foot was inside the line.
Stumping appeal is taken upstairs against Chase...
Chase gets behind the line of the delivery and shows a straight bat.
Full and around off, Dowrich drives it through mid off for a single.
Loopy ball around middle, flicked just in front of short leg.
Full and around off, Dowrich lunges forward and defends it down.
Tad full on off, Chase gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to covers.
Loopy ball on the legs, worked to mid on for a single.
Serves it on off, defended off the front foot.
On middle and leg, Chase gets to the pitch of the ball and plays it to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball on off, pushed to covers.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Dowrich slog sweeps it to the leg side for thre runs.
FOUR! Similar shot was played on the last ball of the last over. Flighted delivery around middle, Dowrich gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it towards square leg for a one bounce boundary.
SD has punched the ball off the back foot.
On middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Dowrich gets an outside edge as is lucky as the ball falls short of first slip. Single taken.
Loopy ball around off, Shane pushes it towards covers.
Flighted delivery around off, Dowrich lunges forward to defend but gets an outside edge past first slip for  a couple.

SIX! Chase has nailed it! he was eyeing to play a similar shot on the last ball but this time he gets it right. Full and around middle and leg, Chase bends down and slog sweeps it over square leg for a maximum. Shot, that!
Loopy ball around middle, Chase gets down on one knee to slog it but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball rolls just past the stumps to Saha.
FOUR!  Worked away on the leg side! Loopy delivery around leg, Chase clears his front leg and flicks it beautifully through wide mid on for a boundary.
Chase drives it towards covers.
Roston drives it towards covers.
Leg spinner around off, Chase defends it off the front foot.
Loopy ball around off, Dowrich presses forward and drives towards the man at mid off.
On middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Loopy ball around off, driven towards mid off this time.
Tossed up around middle and off, Dowrich lunges forward and drives it towards covers.
Full and around off, driven towards covers.
Short and going down the leg side, it's flicked off the pads towards leg slip.
Full and around middle, Chase drives it back to the bowler. Mishra collects the ball and throws it back at the striker's end.
On the pads, worked straight to mid on.
Slider around middle, Chase defends it off the front foot.
A slip is taken off now...
On middle and leg, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
FOUR! Swept away! Loopy delivery down the leg side, Dowrich gets down on one knee and sweeps it elegantly through backward square leg for a boundary to start the over.
Full and around off, Dowrich prods forward and drives it to the man at covers.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, pushed to mid-wicket.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
SHANE DOWRICH will bat next.
Drinks are on the field!

OUT! Ashwin strikes and Blackwood is gone! Ashwin from around the wicket serves a tossed up ball on middle and leg. Blackwood comes forward and tries to defend. In the process, he bends a bit extra and the ball goes off the inside edge via pads to the leg side. Pujara at short leg sees the ball falling to his left side and he sticks his left hand. The ball  sticks and the prized wicket of the dangerman is achieved, he has to walk back after playing so well. The mammoth 93-stand is broken after that explosive counter-attack.
Serves it on the pads, it falls off the inside edge to the leg side.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Blackwood pushes it to mid-wicket. Kohli is animated with that.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
On middle and leg, Chase off the back foot plays it to mid-wicket.
Tad short outside off, Chase sets back and cuts it to covers.
Loopy ball on outside off, Chase gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it to the off side.
Serves it on off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
AMIT MISHRA to bowl now.
full ball on middle and leg, Chase plays it to the leg side.
On the middle and leg, Chase confidently plays to mid-wicket.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Serves it on the legs, played to the leg side.
FOUR! Back foot punch! Short ball outside off, Blackwood gets back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, defended off the front to covers.
On a length and around off, Chase looks to poke at it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge of the willow.
Shortish on middle, Chase mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Flayed! Short of a length delivery outside off, Blackwood stays put inside the crease and looks to slash it hard through point. Gets an outside edge that flies past gully and third slip for a boundary towards third man.
On the pads, Blackwood works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
On a good length and outside off, Chase gets back and punches it sweetly through covers but will get only a single.
Full and around off, defended gently off the front foot gently.
Tossed up around middle and off, Blackwood looks to defend it off the front foot but gets a slight inside edge on the pads.
Full and around off, driven through covers for a single.
8th Test fifty for Jermaine Blackwood!
That's back-to-back fifties for JB! Drops it short on middle, Blackwood camps back and pulls it behind square on the on side for a single. He is taking the attack to the opposition.
Short and down the leg side, Blackwood looks to play at it but misses.
SIX! That went many a mile! Floated ball around off, Blackwood gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it neatly back over Ashwin's head for a maximum. Just 1 short of another fifty now.
Harmless length delivery on middle, defended with a straight bat.
Tad full and angling in this time, the batsman offers a solid front foot defence.
On a length and outside off, punched towards covers.
FOUR! Short of a length delivery on middle, Chase walks across and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards covers for a single.
Short and down the leg side, Blackwood looks to help it on its away but misses.
Flicked through the leg side for a single.

FOUR! That's hit hard! Flighted ball around off, Blackwood comes down the track and drills it powerfully back to the bowler. Ashwin initially looks to grab it with his left hand but seeing the ball coming hard at him he pulls his hand out. The ball goes blazing towards the long off fence for a boundary.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Chase gets forward and bunts it down to long on for a single.
Full and around off, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up around middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards mid off.
Ravichandran Ashwin into the attack now.
On the pads, Blackwood glances it to the leg side for a brace.
FOUR! Muscled! Blackwood is going all guns blazing! Ishant pitches it up on off, Blackwood confidently lofts it over mid off for a boundary. What a clean shot there by the Caribbean lad.
Peach! Length ball on off, Blackwood was not in a frame to play that and gets beaten hands down. Good ball there.
Ravichandran Ashwin is seen warming up...
Tad short ball outside off, Blackwood likes the width and cuts it hard only to find the cover fielder.
Full ball on off, pushed to covers for a single.
Short ball on off, Chase tries to pull it away but gets hit on the unmentionable part of the body. Nasty one.
Short ball down the leg side, worked to long leg for a single. It is actually a leg bye.
Angles in a length ball from outside off, Chase gets beaten while defending it and the ball hits his stomach. Some beating for Chase in this over .
Length ball on off, pushed to covers confidently.
Back with a full ball on middle and leg, this time Roston gets his block in place to push it to mid-wicket.
The physio is out in the middle to assist Chase, he looks in some pain out there.
Short ball on middle and off, Chase off his back foot tries to fend it. It has hit his thumb and he is in agony.
Wayward length down the leg side. Chase lets it through.
A better line on middle and leg, Blackwood pushes it to mid-wicket. End of an over. This pair is running away with the runs this session.
The batsman gets a bottom edge on that one.
50-run stand between Blackwood and Chase.
FOUR! That's a clean hit. Full ball on off, Blackwood lofts it over the covers for a boundary. Great strike that.
Good block off that full ball on the off stump.
Good length this, it is pitched up outside off. Jermaine sees it go back to the keeper.
Short ball down the leg side, left alone.
Steaming in full ball on off, Chase off his front foot plays it to covers.
Tad short but it angles down the leg. Chase is all ready to push to mid-wicket.
A good length ball on middle and leg, Chase in his response stays back and defends it back to the bowler.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Leg bye. Fuller ball on the pads, Blackkwood looks to flicks it to long leg but it goes off his thigh pad for a single.
Short ball on off, Blackwood hops and fends it to the off side.
Wide. Wayward length down the leg side, left alone. It is signalled as wide.

FOUR! Driven, and driven classically! Fuller ball on off, it lures Chase and he obliges it by cover driving through the cover region. Mishra chases it and puts in a dive to save it but the ball touches the ropes.
Back of a length ball outside off, Chase is all relaxed to let it through.
Full ball outside off, left alone. The partnership is 42 from run a ball. It is been a good positive intent so far by the hosts.
A good length ball on middle and off, a solid textbook defence by Chase back to the bowler.
A tad full but outside off, Chase is all alert as he is not poking at that outside off length.
Full ball outside off, left alone to begin with.
Length ball on the legs, Chase glances it through square leg for a single.
Tad short outside off, Chase hops and fends it into the track.
Length ball on off, pushed to covers for a quick single.
Nope, it is from over the wicket now and a tad full on off, Blackwood is still not interested to play at it.
Another short ball on middle and leg, Blackwood lets it through to the keeper. I guess the ploy is to bowl short and invite him for a pull or hook.
Umesh from around the wicket! It goes over the batsman's head. He ducks to evade it.
Umesh Yadav into the attack now.
Hurls it fuller on off, left alone. Maiden for Ishant to start with.
Fuller and on the 6th stump line on off, Chase sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Tad short this time on the wickets, a mere fend to covers.
Another length ball outside off, Chase shoulders his arms.
Length baall outside off, Chase leaves it for the keeper.
Full ball wide outside off, left alone. The ploy of bowling wide outside off is on straightaway.
Ishant Sharma into the attack.
FOUR! Over mid off this time! Hurls it fuller outside off, Blackwood goes uppish by playing full stroke off his bat over mid off for a boundary. 10 runs in last 2 balls.
SIX! Downtown! Blackwood you beauty! Length ball on middle and leg, Jermaine likes the line and goes after it by lofting it down the ground for a surprised beggie.
A perfect length ball on off, Blackwood strides forward and gets to the pitch of the ball to block it.
Hurls a fuller length here, Blackwood off his front food defends it.
FOUR! Postitive intent! Length ball on off, Blackwood stands tall and drives it through mid off for a racy boundary.
Full ball on middle and leg, pushed to the leg side for a single.
More runs! Tossed up ball outside off, Chase leans into it and drives it through the covers. Ishant Sharma puts in a chase to save a run. Three runs taken at the end. Expensive over there.
No ball. Tossed up ball on middle, pushed through the leg side for a brace. It is a no ball too for overstepping.
FOUR! Neat work of the wrists! Loopy ball on middle and leg, Chase steps ahead and uses his wrists to perfection by keeping the ball down through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Darts it full on off, played back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball outside off, spinning away from the batsman and he lets it through too.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball on the pads, Chase pushes it by going on the back foot to mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Another one through that region! Length ball, moving away from the batsman. Blakwood is all ready to play his late cut shot and succeeds yet again to get the ball to the fence.
Hurls a lenegth ball on middle and leg, pushed to mid on.
FOUR! Steered away! A perfect length ball outside off, Blackwood likes it and he manoeuvres it through backward point for a welcome boundary. Good technique there.
That was a close shave! Length ball on middle and off, Blackwood stays tall and plays it with soft hands. It goes on to hit the pad via an inside edge.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Jermaine looks to go over the top but the ball seams away and he gets beaten up.
Angles a length delivery on middle, Blackwood looks to flick it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Loopy ball on off, Chase comes ahead and pushes it to the off side. End of the over.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, played to covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short ball on middle and leg, Chase comes to the pitch of the ball and chases it well to pull it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Easy runs there.
Similar ball on the legs, Blackwood bat-pads it to short leg and they cross for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, defended off the front foot.
Amit Sharma will bowl from the other end.
Short and down the leg side, Roston goes to pull that away. He misses and they appeal for a caught behind. The umpire denies as he feels nothing was there when it went to the keeper.
The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. Jeramaine Blackwood and Roston Chase will be the two West Indian batsmen. Mohammed Shami will complete his pending over. Here we go...
As of now, the forecast looks superb for playing and we are waiting for the same. Let's see how the hosts fare the new ball and show some skin to draw this match. Do join us in a bit.

A result is surely on the cards if the weather allows to have a quota of 98.1 overs provided we have an early start too. Team India is surely on the front foot and will like to take wickets really quick and win another Test match and go 2-0 up in this 4-match Test series.

Hello and a warm welcome, folks! We are back for the final day of this 2nd Test match between West Indies and India. The visiting side is already sitting in a comfortable position by posting a mammoth lead of 304 off which the Caribbean side is still trail by 256 and having 6 wickets in hands.
... Day 5, Session 1 ...

For the time and the overs lost today, play will start earlier tomorrow, at 0930 local time, 2000 IST. We'll have 98.1 overs, provided the conditions pertain to do so. Hope tomorrow is much, much better than these last couple of days. Hope you join us for the last and final day of this Test match. Till tomorrow, take care and good night!

India won't mind this scenario much at all. We saw only 16 overs bowled today, but the visiting side plucked 4 wickets in that period and now they just need 6 more wickets to win this match. West Indies are in some real trouble here. Chances to save this match looks really bleak, and the forecast for tomorrow isn't as bad, just maybe a couple of passing thunderstorms.

Update 0225 IST - Well, the condition haven't exactly improved. The rains have stopped, but it's still very overcast and the light is still an issue. And the showers pounding down have done the damage. The call has been made that the ground conditions aren't suitable for playing today. Hence, PLAY HAS BEEN CALLED OFF!

Update 0133 IST - It's gotten darker and now, we have a lot of thundering, and then quite a lot of lightning as well. The rains have started again and the covers are back on. Doesn't look too good out there. This begs the question if we'll have any play today. Hope we do. Stay with us, we'll keep you posted.

Update 0116 IST - There's some good news. The rain has stopped and the super sopper has been brought on. The water is being dried off the covers as the groundstaff start their work. There's a good chance that some amount of damage must have been done to the ground. So the fourth umpire Gregory Brathwaite is out there as well to inspect the conditions and the extent of the damage. We'll update you once we have any word from the center.
UPDATE 0047 IST - It's raining heavily now, we might have a big delay. West Indies won't mind this at all.

We are back for the second session only to find that it's raining again. Frustrating news for India as the rain gods have decided to ruin the fun. The only way by which West Indies would have survived longer was if weather intervened and that has happened. It's highly overcast out there and the covers are on. So stay tuned for further updates.
... DAY 4, SESSION 2 ...

Later in the session, Mohammed Shami came to the party as he sent back Marlon Samuels for a duck. Darren Bravo who was struggling a lot out in the middle and surviving by whiskers finally fell to Shami's bouncer just before Lunch. 4 wickets down already without a single over from Ravichandran Ashwin, so how long will it take for the visitors to clean them up? Join us for the second session at 0010 IST.

What an eventful day! After a delayed start to the day, and numerous interruptions due to the rains, India has hit the bull's eye in this session! They have completely outclassed the West Indies top order. Ishant Sharma began the proceedings of the home side's downfall by cleaning up Rajan Chandrika. Kraigg Brathwaite and Darren Bravo tried to fight out in the middle but weren't successful as the opener fell to Amit Mishra.

OUT! MOHAMMED SHAMI, YOU LITTLE RIPPER! What a ball! Bang. Speading the smiles, his teammates are ecstatic and why shouldn't they be? He comes from around the wicket to Bravo, bangs this one in short and angling in, it's a sharp one and the southpaw is completely taken by surprise. He's in no position to play this and just tries to bring his bat up to it. Gets a healthy edge which flies to Lokesh Rahul at second slip. That's his second catch of the day and he takes it well. And with this wicket, the umpire has decided that will be enough. LUNCH WILL BE TAKEN NOW!

Shami bowling really well here. Bowls a length ball on middle and off, just straightens up a shade as Jermaine Blackwood tries to block this with a straight bat. He gets a leading edge which goes through covers. A single is taken.
Fuller delivery outside off, Blackwood drives this through the covers and gets a couple of runs for it.
Full and fired in on the stumps, driven back into the bowler's hands.
Back of a length around off, Jermaine hops and works it straight to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Poor delivery, shown the way! Shortish delivery outside off, Bravo gets back in his crease and thumps it through covers for a superb boundary.
Loopy delivery, DB defends it off the front foot.
Pitched outside leg, spinning away, Bravo leaves it alone.
Bravo looks to sweep the delivery but fails.
Quicker one on middle, defended straight back to the bowler.
Leg spinner, pitched on off, Bravo looks to flicks but misses and gets hit on pads.
Aimed at the top of off stump, Blackwood stays back and with a nice straight bat, bunts it back towards the bowler. End of a very good over from Mohammed Shami.
JERMAINE BLACKWOOD has come out in the middle to partner Darren Bravo.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! And Samuels is gone. Shami with a good line and with some luck, sends Marlon packing. Length delivery on middle and off, some away movement there and the ball keeps a little low as well. Samuels is all but beaten as he tries to bring his bat down to this one. The ball beats the outside edge and knocks the off stump over. Big wicket for the Indians and they know that.
Staying on the shorter side once more, holds the length back and bangs it outside off, once again it isn't bothered with.
Tad shorter in length and well outside off, no shot offered to this one.
Length delivery outside off, left alone for Saha to gobble up.

Shami welcomes Samuels with a short one, and he isn't expecting this one bit. It hurries on to him and he's left there blank. Just about manages to get a glove on it and the ball then goes off his chest.
MARLON SAMUELS is the new man in.

OUT! THE BOWLING CHANGE DOES THE TRICK! Spin once again does the business. Shorter and flatter on middle and leg, Brathwaite goes back and goes for the pull. Goes into the shot too early which does him in. Gets a thick top edge which balloons towards mid-wicket and Lokesh Rahul there makes no mistake. Runs back and takes a well judged catch, never taking his eyes off the ball. Second wicket down for West Indies and that too just before the break.
Ravichandran Ashwin is seen warming up. By the look of it, he is to bowl next.
On middle and leg, tucked towards short fine leg. No run taken.
Some flight on this one from Mishra, pitches it outside off, it's driven towards covers, straight to the fielder.
Looped up on middle and off, Brathwaite comes forward and pushes it back down the ground. Gets no run for it.
Floats this one up on the stumps, it's worked to mid-wicket for no run.
Mishra starts off with a tossed up delivery on off, Kraigg presses forward to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge. Luckily for him, he played that with soft hands.
AMIT MISHRA has the ball in his hand now.

FOUR! Bravo is highly uncomfortable there, isn't he? This one is outside off, he just stands there and throws his bat at this. Gets a thick outside edge which flies through point. Races away to the fence for a boundary.
Pitched outside off, no trouble for the southpaw to not play at it.

FOUR! EDGED AND AWAY! Shami with another shortish delivery, this time it's angled in on the body, a touch straighter too, Bravo stays back and looks to pull this away fine on the leg side. Instead, he gets a thick top edge which flies over the keeper's head and away to the boundary.
On a length and outside off, angling in to the left-hander, he prods forward and taps it towards point.
Back of a length ball around off, Darren gets behind the line and blocks it out.
Shami from around the wicket, with a shortish delivery angling in to Bravo, he manages to play at this one. Taps it away square on the off side.
Tad short outside off, coming in sharply, it's still well out and so, left alone comfortably for the keeper to collect. End of the over.
Another excellent length delivery pitched outside off, Ishant really bending his back into it, there's a lot of movement as the ball goes past the batsman.
Good length ball outside off, it's watchfully let by.
Full delivery just outside off, Kraigg gets behind the line and drives it back in the bowler's direction.

Within a blink of an eye, the rain has gone, it's bright and sunny and the players are back in action. Rain is teasing everyone present out there in the Caribbean and also the fans who are staying up late night in India.
Here comes the rain again! The players are running back to their dressing room. Rain gods are playing hide and seek with the players! God bless those groundsmen, who are on duty today.

FOUR! Connects it well this time. Ishant with another short delivery, Brathwaite is up for this one. Hops a little and pulls it through the mid-wicket region to send it all the way to the fence. Latched on to that one and put it away so well. Super shot.

Ishant Sharma steaming in, bowls a slightly shortish delivery outside off, Brathwaite has room to swing his arms and he goes for it. Looks to have a little pull through mid-wicket but ends up getting an inside edge which falls just short of a diving Wriddhiman Saha.
Back of a length, directed on the body of the batsman, this time Bravo keeps it down towards leg slip.
Length delivery outside off, KB gets back in his crease to defend it but gets a leading edge towards backward point for a single.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
On the off stump, defended towards covers.
Bravo punches the ball towards the covers for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Brathwaite pushes it to covers for a single.
Outside off, DB gets his bat forward but gets beaten yet another time. What's going on with Bravo?
Bravo flicks off his thigh pad, past leg slip for a couple. Rahul at leg slip dives to his left but is unable to stop it.
Darted in full and on middle, the batsman digs it out on the off side.
Wide down the leg side, Bravo leaves it alone.
Fuller in length, pushed towards mid off for a single.
Length delivery outside off, angling in, Brathwaite leaves it watchfully.
Pitched on a length outside off, Bravo shoulders his arms to that one.
Bouncer! Darren Bravo ducks to evade it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery around off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Beaten again! Bravo is looking very underconfident out there. He again gets beaten outside off.
BEATEN! Length delivery outside off, Bravo tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten past his outside edge.
Pitched outside off, Bravo not interested to have a go at it.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Fuller on pads, DB flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Drifting down the leg side, Bravo tries to flick it but misses. He is living dangerously out there.
Brathwaite punches the ball towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Brathwaite shoulders his arms.
Outside off, Bravo defends it on the off side.
Back of a length angled into the batsman, Bravo awkwardly fends at it.
Bravo defends the delivery with the full face of his bat.
Touch back of a length drifting down the leg side, DB flicks it past leg gully for a brace.
Length delivery around off, Bravo defends it off the back foot.
Bravo defends it within his crease.
Pitched outside off, KB plays it towards point.

FOUR! Edged and raced towards fence! Teasing delivery outside off, Brathwaite tries to defend it off the front foot. The ball hits the outside edge of the bat but falls short of second slip. The ball runs away for a boundary through the third man region.
Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
The batsman offers no shot to the ball outside his off stump.
NO BALL! Pitched outside off, KB chooses to leave it. Sharma oversteps this time and the umpire signals a no ball.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders his arms.
Back of a length delivery, Brathwaite cuts it over the backward point fielder for a couple.
Brathwaite gets a leading edge for a length delivery towards covers for a single.
BEATEN! Pitched on a length outside off, Brathwaite looks to defend it but gets beaten past his inside edge.
Outside off, left alone.
On the pads, the bastman flicks it to short leg.

FOUR! Lucky! Pitched on a length outside off, angling in Brathwaite tries to defend it within his crease but gets an inside edge past the wicketkeeper, who dives to his left but can't stop it. The ball runs towards fence for a boundary.
Bravo has been hit on the arm it seems. Must have stung as he sits down clutching his arm. He seems to be okay though to continue.

From around the wicket, Shami bangs it short and into the batsman, Bravo gets his arm in front of him and gets hit on gloves as he fends awkwardly at it. The ball runs towards square leg. The batsmen pick a single.

The players are back out in the middle, the umpires have taken their positions and there's a nice breeze blowing. Still pretty dark, quite a lot of dark clouds still hovering about. It will be Darren Bravo and Kraigg Brathwaite to continue with the bat as Mohammed Shami will take the ball.
Update 2217 IST - The showers have once again passed, although it is still pretty dark out there. Word from the middle is that play will resume at 2230 IST, 1200 local time.

Update 2155 IST - Oh, dear! Just when the players were walking out in the middle and the umpires were taking their positions, it's started to pour heavily. The covers are pulled on and we are going to be in for another delay. Got to feel for the groundsmen here, this constant stop-start situation is good for no one, especially them. Tireless work. We'll keep you guys updated with the situation. Stay tuned.

Update 2147 IST - The covers are now coming off as the rain has stopped and some sawdust is being sprinkled near the run-up area, right where the bowlers plant their foot before releasing the ball out of their hand. So, play will resume at 2155 IST, 1125 local time.
Oh well, look at that... It has almost stopped raining. It's much brighter now and seems play will resume soon enough. We'll update you guys as soon as there's some news from the middle.

Oh, my word. The players and the umpires are now going off the field as the rain has started to fall, that too heavily. We've witnessed just 15 minutes of play and that was enough for India to bag a wicket. The covers have been brought on and we will see a halt in play.
On the pads, Bravo flicks it to square leg for a single.
Pitched outside off, DB offers no shot.
Outside off, Bravo shoulders his arms.
DARREN BRAVO is the next man in.

OUT! FIRST ONE TO FALL! Length ball outside off, bounces little extra off the pitch. Chandrika leans forward trying to leave it but gets hit on his elbow and onto the stumps. What a way to get out! There was nothing in the ball to get the better of the batsman, totally his fault. Ishant makes the first breakthrough and Rajan Chandrika has to walk back.
Outside off, left alone.
Length ball outside off, angling slightly in, Chandrika looks to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten past his inside edge.
Drifting down leg, Kraigg has a go at it but misses.
Outside off, KB pushes it to point.
Length ball pitched on the off stump, Brathwaite looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Appeal for lbw by Shami which is declined politely by the umpire.
Back of a length, Brathwaite pulls it into the ground towards square leg for a couple  .
Poor delivery, wide down the leg side, Brathwaite leaves it.
Length ball drifting down the leg side, Chandrika gets across and works it off his thigh pad for a single towards fine leg. He is off the mark.
Length ball aimed at the stumps, Brathwaite defends it towards mid on.
Pitched outside off, Kraigg chooses to leave it.
Length ball wide outside off, Brathwaite stands tall and cuts it past point for a couple.
Wide outside off, KB leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, Brathwaite cuts it to backward point.
Outside off, Brathwaite shoulders his arms.
